description: This file implements an email sending API for the TestLink project, including functions to send emails via different methods, handle email configurations, and integrate with PHPMailer. It provides wrappers and configuration handling for email dispatching within the TestLink system.

methods.name: email_send_wrapper
methods.description: A wrapper function for sending emails that consolidates options and calls the core email_send function.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Sends an email using PHPMailer, configured via system settings, supporting different sending methods and handling attachments, recipients, and email formatting.

methods.name: email_smtp_close
methods.description: Closes an open SMTP connection maintained by PHPMailer, if any.

methods.name: make_lf_crlf
methods.description: Converts line feeds in a string to CRLF sequences for email formatting.

methods.name: email_append_domain
methods.description: Appends a domain to an email address if the domain restriction is enabled in configuration.
